preconditions: The shared I2C bus must already be configured.
The board must expose a reset signal if hardware reset is required.
steps: Drive reset inactive using the configured active level.
Probe the configured I2C address after any required settle delay.
Enable board-local interrupt handling only after the device responds.

validationHooks.description: Assert and release reset if wired.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The reset path can be exercised using the configured board signal.
failureNotes: A bad reset polarity can keep the device permanently offline.

validationHooks.passCriteria: The part responds on its configured I2C address after reset handling.
failureNotes: A bad reset polarity can keep the device permanently offline.

validationHooks.description: Read the board-mapped interrupt input for a stable idle state.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The interrupt signal can be sampled through the board mapping.
failureNotes: Interrupt inactivity alone is not a failure if I2C probe succeeds.

checks: Assert and release reset if wired.
Read the board-mapped interrupt input for a stable idle state.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The part recovers from reset and responds on I2C.
failureNotes: A bad reset polarity can keep the device permanently offline.
Interrupt inactivity alone is not a failure if I2C probe succeeds.

highLevel.name: rfid_reset
highLevel.description: Control the board-mapped reset line for the RFID device.

highLevel.name: rfid_is_present
highLevel.description: Return whether the device responded during setup.

highLevel.name: rfid_poll
highLevel.description: Poll the controller for card or field status.
